author: Spyxi
quote: It’s a great entry in the GTA series, but it doesn’t deserve its score—let alone the "Game of the Year" (GOTY) title. The quality fell short compared to what was shown in the trailers; the game is full of bugs—and while they might not ruin the overall experience, one would expect better from a title that spent 13 years in development. The story is incredible, which is a major plus, and the references will be greatly appreciated by fans of the series. Sadly, in terms of the actual experience, it didn’t offer any real surprises.

author: Spyxi
quote: Pure cinema. The soundtrack was spot on. A very well-executed game, crafted with care.

author: Spyxi
quote: I think it’s a great game—one of the greatest of all time. It was my first time playing it, and it’s truly impressive in every aspect: the story, the music, the sound, and the graphics—which are absolutely incredible compared to previous installments. For me, it’s the game of the year.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
